test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

He gave a large amount of donation for flood victims and everyone appreciated his __magnanimous__ act.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Chivalrous**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnanimous **means generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful. (उदार और क्षमाशील, विशेषकर प्रतिद्वंद्वी या किसी कम शक्तिशाली व्यक्ति के प्रति)

 
 
• **For example**: *Despite their fierce competition, John was magnanimous in defeat and congratulated his opponent warmly.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Chivalrous **means showing honor, courtesy, and respect, typically towards women. (आमतौर पर महिलाओं के प्रति सम्मान, शिष्टाचार और सम्मान दिखाना)
 
 
• **For example**: *Mark's chivalrous behavior towards his date included holding the door open and pulling out her chair at the restaurant.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about someone donating a large amount to flood victims and everyone appreciated it, which shows the person's chivalrous nature.
 
• So, the synonym for 'magnanimous' is 'chivalrous'.

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vindictive**: Having or showing a strong or unreasoning desire for revenge. (बदला लेने की प्रबल या अनुचित इच्छा होना या प्रदर्शित होना)
 
• **Chimerical**: Existing only in the imagination; fanciful. (केवल कल्पना में विद्यमान; काल्पनिक)
 
• **Cherubic**: Having the childlike innocence or plump prettiness of a cherub. (बच्चों जैसी मासूमियत या करूब की मोटी सुंदरता होना)
